Meta 刚刚发布了 Muse Spark Open 的权重，现已在 Modal Auto Endpoints 上线。

inlines.text: Meta 刚刚发布了 Muse Spark Open 的权重，现已在 Modal Auto Endpoints 上线。

blocks.text: Muse Spark Open 专为智能体编程和长周期任务打造，具备原生多模态理解能力和 100 万 token 上下文窗口。它支持编写和调试代码、多步规划、顺序工具调用，以及跨长流程工作流的故障恢复。

inlines.text: Muse Spark Open 专为智能体编程和长周期任务打造，具备原生多模态理解能力和 100 万 token 上下文窗口。它支持编写和调试代码、多步规划、顺序工具调用，以及跨长流程工作流的故障恢复。

blocks.text: 在 Meta 的评估中，Muse Spark Open 使用 Terminus 2 智能体在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上得分 76.4，使用 Meta 首选测试框架在 DeepSWE 1.1 上得分 60，推理强度为 xhigh。基准测试结果和评估设置请参见已发布的模型卡。

Meta just released weights for Muse Spark Open, and it’s now available on Modal Auto Endpoints.

inlines.text: Meta just released weights for Muse Spark Open, and it’s now available on Modal Auto Endpoints.

blocks.text: Muse Spark Open is built for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks, with native multimodal understanding and a 1M-token context window. It supports writing and debugging code, multi-step planning, sequential tool use, and failure recovery across extended workflows.

inlines.text: Muse Spark Open is built for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks, with native multimodal understanding and a 1M-token context window. It supports writing and debugging code, multi-step planning, sequential tool use, and failure recovery across extended workflows.

blocks.text: In Meta’s evaluations, Muse Spark Open scores 76.4 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 using the Terminus 2 agent and 60 on DeepSWE 1.1 using Meta’s preferred harness, with xhigh reasoning effort. See the released model card for the benchmark results and evaluation settings.
